metadata.description: Lim-Tec agent tooling for Siemens servo sizing, ordering and quoting.

plugins.name: siemens-servo-selector
plugins.description: Size a Siemens servo motor (V90 / S200 / S200 Compact / S210 / S120) for a duty point and get a ready-to-order bill of materials: motor, matched drive, power / encoder / brake cables, with full order numbers, USD reference prices and a digit-by-digit order-number explanation. 160 motors, 0.05-69 kW. Use when sizing, cross-referencing, pricing or ordering Siemens SIMOTICS servo or spindle motors and SINAMICS drives.

plugins.name: limtec-product-selector
plugins.description: Lim-Tec product selection for screw jacks, servo electric cylinders and linear actuators: model, full order code, engineering checks and a priced bill of materials with USD reference prices. Use when sizing or quoting a screw jack (SJA / SJB / KV / EHB / SCA / SCB), a servo electric cylinder (DMB / EMB / GTR / FMR) or a linear actuator (LAP / LBP / LAM / LBM), building an order code, or looking up a Lim-Tec price.
